verdict.rationale: Mercury exposes a comprehensive REST/CLI API (transactions, statements, invoices, customers, categories, cards, treasury) that lets a technical user programmatically pull essentially all account data as JSON and PDF statements, and llms.txt/OpenAPI-flavored docs support open-format access. However there is no explicit 'export everything and close/leave' feature, bulk data-portability tool, or documented full account/data export beyond API-level pulls, so the capability exists but only via developer effort, not a turnkey export.
